candidates.title: [ux-sim] The first screen looks like a dating app: one big face photo and an "I'm in" button
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Six of the seven personas opened the app and their first reaction was "is this a dating app?" — a full-height photo of one person with name and age, and a lime "I'm in" button, whatever they came for (clubs, internships, rides, lunch).

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence high · **6 simulated persona(s)** across 6 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The signed-in home is a single swipe card centred on a person (photo, name, age) rather than on the plan; the plan title is secondary text. Nothing on the screen says it is about plans with classmates.

### Evidence

- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 0 — “Wait, the first thing I see is a big photo of a stranger named Maya and an 'I'm in' button. I came to find a club… is this a dating thing? I don't want to accidentally tap 'I'm in' and sign up for coffee with someone I don't know.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-diego-lunch-today` step 0 — “OK, a big face photo first thing. Coffee tomorrow at 6 isn't lunch today. Is this a dating thing or a plans thing? I just want lunch people.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley` step 0 — “I'm on a 1440px laptop and I get a phone-width column with a giant face photo and an 'I'm in' button. Is this a dating app? I came for internships.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving` step 0 — “어... 큰 얼굴 사진? 데이트 앱인가? 공항 가는 차 찾으려고 왔는데 커피 약속이 나와요. 영어만 있고... 한국어 설정 어디 있지?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `smoke-minji-lunch-today` step 0 — “헐 big face photo… is this a dating app? And 'I'm in' — in what, coffee with Maya or matching with her?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-minji-timetable-add-classes` step 0 — “헐 첫 화면이 큰 얼굴 사진에 'Maya 24'... 데이팅앱이야? 나 시간표 넣으러 온 건데 어디서 하지” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-timetable-add-classes/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-timetable-add-classes/shots/000-start-som.jpg)

### Environment note

Pilot runs used the shared demo account, so the face was a sample profile (Maya). The layout is the same for real accounts — re-check with auth: fresh runs.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Lead the card with the plan ("Lunch at Crossroads · today 12:30 · 3 spots") and make the person secondary (smaller avatar, no age on the card); show 2–3 plans as a list on first open instead of one full-screen face.

candidates.title: [ux-sim] After "I'm in" it is unclear what you joined and where its chat is
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Personas tapped "I'm in" without knowing whether it joins a plan or matches with the person; afterwards the button turns into "Joined · Leave" (does tapping again leave?) and the promised group chat is hidden under Messages → Activities.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The button names an attitude, not an action on a thing; the success toast points to a chat that is not on screen and has no direct link.

### Evidence

- run `smoke-minji-lunch-today` step 0 — “헐 big face photo… is this a dating app? And 'I'm in' — in what, coffee with Maya or matching with her?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- run `smoke-minji-lunch-today` step 2 — “뭐지… where is the group chat? and the button now says 'Joined · Leave' — if I tap it again do I leave??” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/002-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/002-click-som.jpg)
- run `smoke-minji-lunch-today` step 6 — “oh there it is, under Activities. took me a while” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/006-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/006-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`smoke-minji-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `minji-freshman-17` · scenarios: `lunch-today`

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Name the action with the plan ("Join lunch"), keep the joined state as a non-destructive label with a separate Leave, and put an "Open chat" button on the card/toast.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] A brand-new account finds nobody to meet and is pushed to create plans itself
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

After a 9-step sign-up the fresh account saw empty People/Discover screens; the only offers were "Invite friends", hackathons and "Create activity". The 17-year-old persona quit rather than invite strangers first.

Severity **4** (Blocker — I could not continue, gave up, or would stop using the app here.) · analyst confidence high · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 2 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Sample profiles are (correctly) hidden from real accounts, and there is no fallback content for an empty campus: no public campus events, no 'people who also want lunch' signal, no low-pressure first step.

### Evidence

- run `baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout` step 43 — “역시 없음. 내가 만들라고? 17살 신입이 모르는 사람들한테 먼저 밥 먹자고 하는 거 너무 어색해. 그만할래” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout/shots/043-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout/shots/043-click-som.jpg)

'Food & café' 하나만 더 눌러보고 없으면 끝” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout/shots/041-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout/shots/041-click-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-diego-lunch-today` step 10 — “Empty. And '7 friends'? I don't have friends on here, those are sample people. Nobody's actually around. Fine, Instant meetup is right there, I'll give it one shot.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/010-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/010-scroll-som.jpg)

Runs: [`baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-minji-cold-start-hangout/report.md), [`baseline-diego-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `minji-freshman-17`, `diego-transfer-commuter` · scenarios: `cold-start-hangout`, `lunch-today`

### Environment note

Local stack has no other real students; live has some. The empty state itself is real for any new campus or quiet hour.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

For empty campuses show low-pressure, real things first (campus events, club tables, 'n students want lunch buddies this week — tap to be counted'), and make 'host' a one-tap templated plan rather than the default answer.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Sign-up asks nine personal questions (hobbies, birth year) before showing anything
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Personas hit a 1/9 progress bar and personality-style questions ("your perfect free afternoon") before seeing any people or content; birth year has no explanation of who sees it; the internship-minded senior could not skip.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **2 simulated persona(s)** across 2 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The quiz front-loads recommendation inputs; the value (people, plans) is shown only after the last step, and visibility of each answer is not stated.

### Evidence

candidates.title: [ux-sim] "Instant meetup" opens a full event form
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

The lunch persona chose "Instant meetup" expecting a one-tap "lunch in 20 minutes" and got title, description, colour, capacity and date fields.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Instant meetup reuses the generic create-activity form with every field visible.

### Evidence

- run `baseline-diego-lunch-today` step 12 — “'Instant'? This is a whole event form. Title, description, color, capacity... and it says 11 PM? I want lunch in 20 minutes. I don't have time for this, and nobody's even on here to see it.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/012-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/012-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`baseline-diego-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `diego-transfer-commuter` · scenarios: `lunch-today`

### Environment note

The persona also objected to an 11 PM default start — correct, because the pilot ran at 23:00 Pacific; only the form length is the finding.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

A 3-field quick form: what (lunch / coffee / study chips), when (now / in 30 min / at 12:30), where (recent places); everything else defaulted and editable after posting.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.body:

That's exactly what makes me nervous.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/023-wait.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/023-wait-som.jpg)

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Club pages don't say plainly whether and how you can join
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

'Not recruiting' next to 'Ask to join', an empty Events tab that talks as if you run the club, and two 'Clubs' buttons left the persona unsure if she was too late or allowed to show up.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Recruiting status, join policy and the empty-state copy are written for club officers, not for prospective members.

### Evidence

- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 28 — “Wait, so they're not recruiting… but I can ask to join? Does that mean I'm too late for this year? Or that it's open anyway? I really don't want to send a request to a club that's closed and look dumb.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/028-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/028-click-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 26 — “Oh good, this is the page. Group runs Tue/Thu at 5pm — that sounds like I could just show up? But then why is it 'Ask to join'… does that mean I have to apply? Would it message someone? And 'Unverified' — is this even the real club?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/026-tap.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/026-tap-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 30 — “No events, but they run twice a week? And 'events you post' — I'm not in charge of this club, why is it talking to me like I am? Members says 3 on Lumi… it feels kind of empty.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/030-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/030-click-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 17 — “Okay, that worked — though there are two buttons both called 'Clubs' right on top of each other, which threw me for a second. Still mostly consulting and VC stuff at the top. Let me scroll.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/017-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/017-click-som.jpg)
- run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 6 — “Fraternity rush, sorority 'formal recruitment', and below it 'fall recruiting' for the indie music club… Wait, does that mean every club makes you try out or apply? That's exactly what I was scared of. And 'Go together' with 'Maya going' — would that message Maya?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/006-scroll.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/006-scroll-som.jpg)

Runs: [`baseline-aisha-find-a-club`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/report.md)

One plain line at the top of every club page: 'Open — just show up Tue/Thu 5pm' / 'Applications closed until spring' / 'Ask to join: the officers reply within N days'; member-facing empty states.
